findings.title: API listener binds even when enabled=false
findings.evidence: With conf.enabled=false, VideoMakerAPI.start() still bound a port and returned a URL; /api/health returned 200 and listener_alive=true. start_api() checks enabled, but the instance start/rebind path does not.
findings.impact: The API off switch is misleading; public routes remain reachable. If lan=true remains set, the listener may stay bound to 0.0.0.0.
findings.recommendation: Check enabled inside start(); disabled means no listener. Test disabling from runtime while LAN mode is currently enabled.

findings.title: Queue can mark an output DONE when only metadata exists
findings.evidence: find_results() returned ready=true and total_bytes>0 for a series containing only info_metadata.txt (13 bytes in harness; no MP4). _finish() uses ready && total_bytes. FinalizeStage writes root metadata before later fail-closed checks.
findings.impact: Orchestrator/webhook can report success for a failed/incomplete release.
findings.recommendation: Use a success sentinel/validated manifest written only after final checks and validate required final MP4s by presence, size, duration/decode.

findings.title: /api/run reports started=true when no pipeline actually started
findings.evidence: With an app whose _start() returns without starting a worker and validate() returns no errors, do_run() returned HTTP 200, started=true while status.running=false.
findings.impact: Schedulers may believe processing began, suppress retries, or misreport a job.
findings.recommendation: Return accepted job id and actual lifecycle state; require an explicit start acknowledgment/state transition, and propagate early GUI validation errors.

findings.title: Checkpoint marks transcription/Gemini stages complete after required JSON save failed
findings.evidence: Injected OSError while writing checkpoint_transcription.json. Saved checkpoint retained TranscribeStage and GeminiStage in completed_stages with transcription_file empty. Restore produced transcription={} and next_stage=MasterBuilder.
findings.impact: Resume can skip analysis stages whose data was not saved, producing incomplete or incorrect outputs.
findings.recommendation: If required stage artifacts fail to persist, do not mark their stage complete and invalidate downstream stages; atomically commit a stage manifest with artifact hashes.

findings.title: Checkpoint does not fingerprint the source or stage-affecting settings
findings.evidence: Resume checks only the exact audio_path string; the saved/compared setting is voice_enhance_requested. The checkpoint has no source stat/hash and no remove_long_pauses, whisper model/language, Gemini prompt/model, caption/hook styles, toggles, B-roll inventory or per-platform BGM fingerprint. A resume with remove_long_pauses=true but no saved pause setting retained completed TranscribeStage and GeminiStage.
findings.impact: Changing a source in place or changing render settings can silently reuse stale transcription, timestamps, analysis, masters and Shorts.
findings.recommendation: Use a versioned source+options fingerprint and a stage dependency map; invalidate only the first affected stage and all downstream stages.

findings.title: TkBridge callback still executes after call() returns TimeoutError
findings.evidence: A fake Tk root delayed its pump. call(fn, timeout=0.01) raised TimeoutError; when the queued pump later ran, it still executed fn and mutated state.
findings.impact: An API request can time out yet start a render later; a retry may duplicate work or the UI response can contradict actual work.
findings.recommendation: Use cancellable task envelopes with queued/running/cancelled/done states and idempotency keys. If already executing, report execution-unknown/in-progress rather than a normal failed start.

findings.title: Existing but empty vertical B-roll folder passes preflight
findings.evidence: With a real horizontal MP4 and an existing empty vertical directory, Settings.validate() returned []. The GUI logs the vertical count but does not reject 0. MasterBuilder delays VSTACK when a directory is configured but has no usable portrait clip; vertical finalization can then operate on an empty input after earlier stages.
findings.impact: The run may spend time on transcription/Gemini/horizontal master before failing to produce the requested vertical result.
findings.recommendation: Validate usable horizontal and vertical assets before the expensive stages; probe file readability/orientation. Skip branches only when explicitly disabled.

findings.title: String booleans silently coerce to True and can desync GUI and Settings
findings.evidence: apply_settings(remove_long_pauses='false') returned applied=[remove_long_pauses], Settings value True, fake GUI variable='false'. queue.pause and allow_duplicate also use bool(value), where bool('false') is True.
findings.impact: API callers can accidentally turn settings on, pause queue, or allow duplicates; UI and server disagree.
findings.recommendation: Strict field schema: booleans must be JSON bool; return 400 for strings/numbers instead of coercion.

findings.title: Failed API port rebind closes the old listener and does not roll back config
findings.evidence: Requested an occupied port; config endpoint returned 500, old port no longer answered and self.conf pointed to the unavailable port.
findings.impact: The control panel can become unreachable until manual recovery/restart.
findings.recommendation: Bind new listener before committing config or restore previous config/listener atomically on failure.

findings.title: Valid JSON with non-object root can crash API or queue setup
findings.evidence: api.json content '1' makes load_config() raise TypeError; queue.json content '1' makes SeriesQueue._load() raise TypeError. Only OSError/ValueError are caught.
findings.impact: A damaged but syntactically valid config/queue can prevent the API runtime from starting.
findings.recommendation: Check root/data schema before update/iteration; back up invalid files and load safe defaults with a clear warning.

findings.title: Whisper model/device/compute UI values are ignored by the engine
findings.evidence: The GUI exposes multiple model/device/compute options; transcribe() always calls the hardcoded MLX_REPO constant and does not pass device/compute_type. Cache keys use MLX_REPO, not the selected model. whisperx_path is passed but ignored.
findings.impact: The UI reports settings that do not affect actual model selection; debugging speed/quality becomes misleading. Startup also searches for WhisperX even though the runtime transcription engine does not use it.
findings.recommendation: Either remove/disable unsupported choices or implement the subset supported by MLX; report the effective model/device and key cache by effective config.

findings.title: Closing GUI hard-exits before worker/checkpoint cleanup completes
findings.evidence: When a pipeline is running, close sets cancel_event and kills FFmpeg children, destroys Tk, then invokes os._exit(0) without joining the worker or confirming that the next checkpoint has persisted.
findings.impact: Closing the window can lose the most recent recovery state and reports success exit code 0 for an interrupted run.
findings.recommendation: Coordinated graceful shutdown: cancel, wait for worker to checkpoint/exit, stop queue/API, then close Tk and use normal process exit.

findings.title: Output metadata/report files exist before finalizer declares success
findings.evidence: BGM report, root metadata, dedup report and upload checklist are written before finalizer may raise for requested BGM failures, missing source assets or missing Shorts.
findings.impact: External tools that test for the presence of sidecars can mistake a partial release for a complete one.
findings.recommendation: Keep diagnostics on failure but write a final status file only after all postconditions; mark manifest as incomplete/failed before raising.

findings.title: No interprocess lock for queue/output series
findings.evidence: Queue uses a shared fixed queue.json.tmp and replacement, but no process-wide lock; existing VERSION.md already notes two app instances can render same series concurrently.
findings.impact: Two instances may clobber queue state, checkpoint JSON, shared _tmp files and same-named output MP4s.
findings.recommendation: Add process singleton lock and per-output-series lock, with stale-lock recovery and multi-instance regression tests.

findings.title: Preflight does not test output writability or available disk space
findings.evidence: Validation verifies path exists but does not write a temporary probe file or check disk capacity/access to the target volume.
findings.impact: Permission/volume/disk-full failures can occur after expensive AI or media stages.
findings.recommendation: Test writable output and temporary directories before processing, check free space and produce a warning estimate where reliable.

findings.title: Config file permissions are hardened after atomic replacement, not before
findings.evidence: api.json.tmp is created with default umask-derived permissions and chmod(0600) is applied only after os.replace().
findings.impact: A short window may expose the API token on multi-user machines with permissive umask.
findings.recommendation: Create the temporary file with mode 0600 (e.g., os.open with explicit mode), then write/fsync/replace.

findings.title: Release documentation and checkpoint index point to stale revisions
findings.evidence: README top line describes CP28 but later sections call CP20 manifest current and CP19/r57-api.6 latest; test-count comment is CP19; VERSION.md contains a stale current-build statement; INDEX says CP19 is latest and does not enumerate CP20-CP28.
findings.impact: Users may restore an old snapshot or follow outdated validation instructions.
findings.recommendation: Generate current-version/checkpoint index from one machine-readable source; add a documentation consistency test.

findings.title: Dead helpers/imports/dependency candidates remain
findings.evidence: AST/grep found no production callers for probe_video_meta, measure_loudnorm_params, apply_loudnorm, vt_encode_args, collect_audio, tokenize_phrase, _word_ends_sentence, _group_words_one_line. save_video_meta_cache is called only by a test. numpy has no direct import in app/tests; hashlib in audio.py and os in power.py appear unused.
findings.impact: Maintenance burden; tests can validate a helper that production never calls; `requirements.txt` also includes pytest in runtime deps.
findings.recommendation: Review public/internal API expectations; delete or reconnect helpers as a unit, rewrite tests to exercise the production path, remove unused imports/deps and move pytest into development requirements.

findings.title: Bool-like strings in webhook and queue pause can enable unintended behavior
findings.evidence: bool('false') evaluates True for allow_duplicate and queue pause, same root as CP29-08 but in HTTP route wrappers.
findings.impact: An orchestrator sending strings instead of JSON booleans can allow duplicate work or pause instead of resume.
findings.recommendation: Treat as part of the CP29-08 schema fix and add route-level tests for false/null/string/number inputs.

findings.title: API remains cleartext HTTP without request-rate limiting
findings.evidence: CP28 explicitly documents no TLS and no rate limiting.
findings.impact: Credentials/status may be exposed on untrusted networks; endpoint may be abused by high request volumes if reachable.
findings.recommendation: Keep loopback-only by default; remote use via VPN/reverse proxy with TLS and rate limiting. Do not port-forward directly to the internet.
